lines.text: Emma went for a quick solo hike and told no one.
Then she took a wrong fork, and her phone lost signal.
Nobody knew where to start looking.
Before every hike, text one person your trail, your parking spot, and the time you'll be back.
Tell them who to call if you're late.
Then check in when you're out.
Emma never skips that text now.
Save this and send it to your hiking friend.
